title: Word and Cowork: legal plugins for Microsoft 365 Copilot add legal skills
summary: The legal-plugin defaults, licensing and governance controls remain supported by Microsoft's documentation, including the two recently changed Cowork pages. The earlier fetch failures did not recur. Minor corrections remain: cite the separate GCC roadmap item and remove two checklist instructions whose controls are not in the table.
